The '''1999–2000 Bundesliga''' was the 37th season of the [[Bundesliga]], Germany's premier football league. It began on 13 August 1999<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.dfb.de/index.php?id=321203 |title=Schedule Round 1 |publisher=DFB |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120928202759/https://www.dfb.de/index.php?id=321203 |archive-date=28 September 2012 }}</ref> and ended on 20 May 2000.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.dfb.de/index.php?id=320840 |title=Archive 1999/2000 Round 34 |publisher=DFB |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120928202811/https://www.dfb.de/index.php?id=320840 |archive-date=28 September 2012 }}</ref> [[FC Bayern Munich]] were the defending champions.

==Competition modus==
Every team played two games against each other team, one at home and one away. Teams received three points for a win and one point for a draw. If two or more teams were tied on points, places were determined by [[goal difference]] and, if still tied, by goals scored. The team with the most points were crowned champions while the three teams with the fewest points were relegated to [[2. Bundesliga]].

==Team changes to 1998–99==
[[1. FC Nürnberg]], [[VfL Bochum]] and [[Borussia Mönchengladbach]] were relegated to the [[1999–2000 2. Bundesliga|2. Bundesliga]] after finishing in the last three places. They were replaced by [[Arminia Bielefeld]], [[SpVgg Unterhaching]] and [[SSV Ulm]].

==Season overview==
<!--THIS SECTION SHOULD COVER GENERAL SEASON EVENTS IN A NEUTRAL AND ENCYCLOPAEDIC STYLE-->
Five matches before the end of the league, [[Bayer Leverkusen]] had 61 points and defending champions [[Bayern Munich]] was in 60. At the 30th fixture, Bayer 04 got 3 points ahead, and continued winning until the 33rd round. Before the final fixture start, Bayer had 73 points, with Bayern having 70. However, Leverkusen lost away to [[SpVgg Unterhaching|Unterhaching]] 2–0, and Bayern celebrated the championship winning against [[Werder Bremen]] 3–1 at home, due to their superior [[goal difference]] over [[Bayer 04]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Ashdown |first=John |date=2012-05-02 |title=When were the closest title races in Europe's top leagues? |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2012/may/02/closest-title-races-the-knowledge |access-date=2024-02-24 |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=May 20, 2020 |title=A helping hand from the neighbours - 20 years on |url=https://fcbayern.com/en/news/2020/05/thank-you-haching |access-date=February 23, 2024 |website=[[FC Bayern Munich]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=20 years ago: The drama of Unterhaching {{!}} Bayer04.de |url=https://www.bayer04.de/en-us/news/bayer04/20-years-ago-the-drama-of-unterhaching |access-date=2024-02-24 |website=Bayer 04 Leverkusen Fussball GmbH |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |author1=Robert O'Connor |date=2021-09-30 |title=The horror treble: remembering the worst collapse in European football |url=https://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/horror-treble-remembering-worst-collapse-european-football |access-date=2024-02-24 |website=fourfourtwo.com |language=en}}</ref>
